description.text:
We are seeking an experienced software engineer to work with our development team & clients. You will be directly working with cross-country elite engineers in the world. Also, you will be joining the software team that is responsible for the development, design, diagnose and troubleshooting, and bug fixing software modules to improve product performance and stability.
1. Analyze, design and implement enterprise-level backend systems and softwares.
2. Participate in the full life cycle of developing complex, high performance and robust backend systems.
3. Work with the engineering team to solve difficult backend problems.
Required Qualifications
1. BS degree in Computer Science or related field.
2. More than 1 year of professional software development experience.
3. Java and Java EE multi-tier development experiences.
4. Excellent knowledge of Object-oriented analysis and design.
5. Strong knowledge of Java multi-threading would be a plus.
6. Familiar with Oracle, MySQL and Linux would be a plus.
